Chapter 1247 - 8 The Kind Ancestors (Request For Monthly Votes At The Beginning Of The Month)

Chapter 1247: Chapter 8 The Kind Ancestors (Request for monthly votes at the beginning of the month)

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun glanced at the bushy-browed, big-eyed Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness.

Still considering them as equals? Here he stands, and if the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness is seen as equals with the Galaxy Venerate, where does that leave him?

The expression of the Xuanyin Ancestor subtly changed.

This old fellow from Barbarian Wilderness, already currying favor? Such a dignified time life form, yet so shameless!

"I think the suggestion from Barbarian Wilderness is a good one," the Da Ling Ancestor nodded, "I also have a great affinity with my dear brother, Galaxy. It’s as if we’ve known each other for a long time, especially considering that the Qingfen Domain where Galaxy first appeared borders Da Ling, which is quite serendipitous."

The Xuanyin Ancestor looked at the Da Ling Ancestor as if seeing him in a new light.

"I am still far from reaching the level of the ancestors," Lin Yuan immediately said.

In terms of strength, he was far inferior to a thirteenth-order ancestor.

If an ancestor bore him any ill will, Lin Yuan couldn’t resist; he would have to abandon everything in this origin world and make plans after stepping into the thirteenth order.

In terms of the years experienced, Lin Yuan was also far behind the ancestors.

Even the youngest Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness is incredibly ancient, translating to countless Cosmic Eras ago in the Chaos Void time.

Thus, Lin Yuan remains quite in awe of the ancestors.

This is respect for forerunners on the evolutionary path.

"Come in and let’s talk slowly."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun spoke, recognizing that having the six ancestors along with Lin Yuan, the future ancestor, standing outside was not ideal, naturally inviting them in for a deeper conversation.

A moment later.

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun led the five ancestors and Lin Yuan to a grand hall within the imperial palace.

This grand hall is of the highest order of the capital’s rules, usually off-limits to even emperors, available only to ancestors. Now with five ancestors visiting, discussions were certainly held in this grand hall.

Before entering this hall, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun had prepared everything, having already instructed his subordinates to bring in precious delicacies and fine wines.

The six ancestors walked into the hall, Lin Yuan followed them, sitting at one of the six seats.

These six seats were of equal height and arranged in a circle, specially arranged by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, with no objections from the other five ancestors.

In their view, Lin Yuan would eventually stand as an ancestor with them. Although the words of the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness, ’consider as equals,’ were slightly flattering, they were true.

No ancestor dared to put on airs in front of Lin Yuan, not even the strongest, Da Fu Ancestor, would do so.

"Hahaha, I’ve longed to taste this pot of ’Fierce God Wine,’ but you, Fierce Sun, are usually too stingy." Da Ling Ancestor smiled and said.

Lin Yuan also sat down and glanced at the ’Fierce God Wine’ mentioned by Da Ling Ancestor.

He had never heard of the name before, but judging by the expression of the Da Ling Ancestor, it was clearly a wine that time life forms greatly desired.

Sequentially, attendants continued to bring in fine foods and wines. The very attendants able to enter and exit this hall were of a Heavenly Venerate level, such a close chance to the ancestors is a rare encounter even for top Peak Venerables.

"I have never seen five ancestors visit together before..."

The attendants entering and exiting the hall couldn’t help but hold their breaths and proceed cautiously.

In the long past, occasionally one of the ancestors might visit the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, but all five ancestors visiting at once? It had never happened.

Especially the oldest, Da Fu Ancestor; for this ancestor to visit was extremely rare, it was always the Ancestor of Fierce Sun visiting Da Fu Ancestor instead.

"And what about this Galaxy Venerate? How does he end up sitting next to the six ancestors?"

An attendant recognized Lin Yuan, known across the entire Fierce Sun Ancient Country among those with some power.

Yet what puzzled the attendants was, what status afforded Galaxy Venerate the privilege to sit alongside the ancestors?

Invincible Venerable’s strength?

How could Heavenly Venerate level strength, no matter how strong, compare when below the ancestor level all were ants in stature?

While attendants were puzzled in thought, seeing Lin Yuan accepted by the ancestors to sit there, they naturally didn’t dare to express any opinions, though their curiosity was inevitable.

Within the hall.

The Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness tasted a sip of ’Fierce God Wine,’ smiling at Lin Yuan, "Dear brother, Galaxy has not yet stepped into the thirteenth order, and yet you possess such strength. Even the ’Abyss Dragon’ at the dawn of creation was no more than this."

"That ’Abyss Dragon’ had such power due to the advantage of creation, but dear brother Galaxy has reached such a state on his own. When you succeed in breaking through, remember to give us a hand."

The attendants entering and leaving heard this, and their minds went suddenly blank.

Help whom?

Help the likes of a thirteenth-order Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness?

Never mind whether the Galaxy Venerate could step into the thirteenth order, even if he could, being on par with the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness, would it be fitting to talk of offering help?

The numerous attendants were shaken, realizing that none of the other ancestors showed any intent to refute but rather silently watched the Galaxy Venerate with smiles.

"I wouldn’t dare presume to help," Lin Yuan said.

At this moment, he realized that the five ancestors likely had foreseen some aspects of his future and thus visited him in advance to cultivate friendship.

Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t refuse such friendly overtures from a time life form, especially considering that he was not yet in the thirteenth order.

Even if faced with murderous intent from a time life form, he could preserve his life, at worst just abandoning everything in this origin world.

But if he could grow smoothly, there was no need to make things difficult for himself.

"By the way, dear brother Galaxy, this is my gift for your first visit,"

The Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness took out a palm-sized jade axe, imbued with a sharp aura capable of severing everything.

This jade axe to Lin Yuan felt even greater than the crimson spear in the treasury of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

"What is this?" Lin Yuan looked at the jade axe before the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness, his expression slightly surprised.

Thirteen-tier weapon.

Did the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness just give it to me like this?

Lin Yuan thought of the Sky Void Tripod in the Chaos Void. Back in the day, Xuanhuang, His Majesty, went to great lengths and made numerous sacrifices to prematurely reach the thirteenth-tier, just to temporarily safeguard that Sky Void Tripod. Even then, it was merely on loan.

If the owner of that thirteen-tier weapon wanted it back, it would just take a thought.

And now, I have obtained a thirteen-tier weapon this easily? And without any repercussions?

"This axe is called the Ancient Source Axe. I discovered a special material named Ancient Source Essence in the gaps between wandering dimensions and spent three billion years refining it. In terms of attack and destruction, it is considered top-notch."

The Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness chuckled and said: "Galaxy, you can’t wield the axe’s power now, but in the future, it should be of some use."

"This is too precious." Lin Yuan gazed at the Ancient Source Axe.

Even though the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness downplayed it, Lin Yuan could still sense that this jade axe was even more precious than an ordinary thirteen-tier weapon.

"It’s nothing." The Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness shook his head and said, "I have found a weapon more suited to me. Keeping this Ancient Source Axe serves no purpose, so I might as well find it a more suitable owner."

"If you find it meaningless, Barbarian Wilderness, you can give it to me," the Xuanyin Ancestor couldn’t help but say from the side.

"Give it to you?" The Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness glared, "You’re not suited for it either."

"Galaxy, don’t despise it," the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness turned to look at Lin Yuan.

"Hahaha, Galaxy, just accept it. It’s a great treasure." The Ancestor of Fierce Sun smiled from the side.

"Yes, accept it." The Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness nodded and promptly pushed the palm-sized jade axe towards Lin Yuan.

"Many thanks." Lin Yuan did not refuse and nodded in thanks.

"Galaxy."

Right then, the Da Fu Ancestor chuckled while looking at Lin Yuan: "Earlier, you specifically requested a hundred pounds of ’Dragon Abyss Blood’, suggesting you’re curious about that ’Abyss Dragon’."

The Da Fu Ancestor continued: "After much thought, I prepared this item for you, Galaxy."

As he spoke, the Da Fu Ancestor revealed a pulsating heart in front of him.

As the heart beat, an invisible force permeated layers of space-time. This heart itself seemed like a miniature source world, emitting terrifying energy with each pulse.

"What’s this?"

"The heart of the Abyss Dragon?"

Having refined a considerable amount of ’Dragon Abyss Blood’, Lin Yuan quickly recognized the heart’s origin.

"Indeed."

The Da Fu Ancestor nodded: "The Abyss Dragon was the first being when this world was just created. It bore countless fortunes and opportunities. When I subdued it, the remaining essence and blood created that treasure ground, Dragon Abyss Valley. However, its most essential part was refined into this heart by me."

"By comprehending this heart, you can gain insight into many secrets of the Abyss Dragon, especially pertaining to the many fortunes of this world’s inception."

The Da Fu Ancestor explained succinctly.

"This?"

Lin Yuan looked at the heart in front of the Da Fu Ancestor, aware of its immense value.

Although the Abyss Dragon wasn’t a thirteen-tier temporal lifeform, it was the first lifeform born from the source world and held an extraordinary connection with it. Comprehending and refining the leftover heart would grant one some of the Abyss Dragon’s essence.

Especially since Lin Yuan sensed the aura of a miniature source world within this heart.

The Abyss Dragon, favored by the heavens and the earth, with each particle carrying a vast world. Its heart nurtured a miniature source world.

Its value surpasses even a thirteen-tier weapon.

"Galaxy, don’t refuse. This heart is of no use to me now," the Da Fu Ancestor said and handed the Abyss Dragon’s heart to Lin Yuan without hesitation.

Then.

The other ancestors also presented their visiting gifts in succession. Whether a thirteen-tier weapon or a rare treasure only found in dimensional gaps, Lin Yuan had never heard of them before.

...

Entering and leaving the great hall, the attendants were numbed. They watched, wide-eyed, as the ancestors gifted the Galaxy Venerate with supreme treasures and rare weapons, especially in such a warm and kind manner.

It almost made the attendants feel like they were seeing a hallucination.

Weren’t the ancestors said to be aloof and cold, treating all living beings like ants?

Even the Da Fu Ancestor, who showed the most fondness for his descendants, would never favor one child particularly strongly.

The Da Fu Ancestor valued the lineage as a whole, not individual offspring.

But now?

All the attendants felt that the ancestors were incredibly kind and warm towards the Galaxy Venerate,

Like a benevolent elder, so different from the cold and ruthless rumors.

...

...

...
